closure_rule: This lane does not close any issue by itself. Source-ready rows require central Rust and exact-candidate validation. Candidate-required rows require receipts bound to the merged source, FTML pin, locks, fixture, runtime, and browser identities. Blocked-evidence rows must remain open unless new authoritative evidence and a matching local authority establish a safe vertical slice.
